title: Zero-Trust Access Management (IAM)
shortDescription: Continuous cryptographic identity verification and adaptive least-privilege enforcement.
fullDescription: Eliminate static passwords and blind network trust with adaptive, context-aware identity verification. Every user request is evaluated against device health, biometric assurance, network posture, and temporal telemetry before granting just-in-time microsegmented access.
features: Continuous Posture Assessment on Every Packet
seoTitle: Zero-Trust Identity & Access Management (IAM) | SPECTRE DEFEND
seoDescription: Phishing-resistant zero-trust access control with continuous biometric verification and ephemeral access gating.
whatIs: SPECTRE DEFEND Zero-Trust Access Management (IAM) is a context-driven identity governance and access platform enforcing phishing-resistant authentication, passwordless passkeys, and continuous device-state verification across all corporate applications.
howItWorks:
1. Passwordless Cryptographic Sign-On: Authenticate users via FIDO2 / WebAuthn hardware credentials.
2. Context Risk Evaluation: Every access attempt analyzes geographic signals, device security compliance, and session history.
3. Just-In-Time Privilege Gating: Elevates privileges on an ephemeral, time-bounded basis for sensitive infrastructure commands.
4. Real-Time Revocation: Instantly terminates active sessions if device health or network parameters deviate from security policy.
whyItMatters: Compromised credentials and phishing attacks remain the #1 root cause of enterprise perimeter breaches. Adopting phishing-resistant hardware authentication renders credential-stealing attacks completely ineffective.
whoItIsFor: Organizations aiming for compliance with US Federal Executive Order 14028, enterprises with remote workforces accessing corporate SaaS applications, and DevOps teams managing production secrets.
deliverables: Single Sign-On (SSO) Portal with 200+ Prebuilt App Connectors
Identity Threat Detection & Session Anomaly Analytics

faqs.question: Can SPECTRE DEFEND integrate with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, or Google Workspace?
faqs.answer: Yes. SPECTRE DEFEND acts as an adaptive zero-trust security layer sitting atop or federating with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace via SAML 2.0 and OIDC.

faqs.question: How are lost hardware passkeys handled securely?
faqs.answer: We provide self-service cryptographic recovery rituals supported by multi-party consensus verification without ever exposing fallback password attack vectors.
